title: FedFiOT: Fisher-Weighted Optimal Transport for Model Merging in One-Shot and Few-Round Federated Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.06783v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: One-shot and few-round federated learning (FL) reduce communication burden by constructing a global model within one or a few communication rounds, but often achieve lower performance than conventional multi-round FL. Without frequent synchronization, client models may drift apart, causing neurons that learn similar features to occupy different positions across clients. At the same time, local data heterogeneity can cause corresponding parameters to differ in their importance to each client's predictions. Together, these challenges cause direct averaging to combine mismatched neurons and assign equal weight to parameters despite differences in their importance. We propose FedFiOT, a Fisher-weighted optimal transport framework for one-shot and few-round FL that leverages Fisher information to quantify parameter importance and guide neuron alignment and model aggregation. FedFiOT jointly optimizes neuron correspondences and global model

translated_title: FedFiOT：用于单轮和小轮次联邦学习中模型合并的Fisher加权最优传输方法
translated_abstract: 单轮和小轮次联邦学习（FL）通过在一次或少数几次通信轮次内构建全局模型来减少通信负担，但其性能通常低于传统的多轮次联邦学习。由于缺乏频繁的同步，客户端模型可能发生漂移，导致学习相似特征的神经元在各客户端占据不同的位置。同时，本地数据的异质性可能导致相应参数对每个客户端预测的重要性存在差异。这些挑战共同导致直接平均法会合并不匹配的神经元，并且尽管参数重要性不同，仍赋予它们相同的权重。我们提出了FedFiOT，一个面向单轮和小轮次联邦学习的Fisher加权最优传输框架，它利用Fisher信息来量化参数重要性，并指导神经元对齐和模型聚合。FedFiOT联合优化神经元对应关系和全局模型……
tldr: FedFiOT提出了一种基于Fisher信息加权的最优传输框架，用于单轮和小轮次联邦学习，通过量化参数重要性来指导神经元对齐与模型聚合，解决了客户端模型漂移和数据异质性导致的直接平均性能下降问题。
en_tdlr: FedFiOT proposes a Fisher-weighted optimal transport framework for one-shot and few-round federated learning that leverages Fisher information to quantify parameter importance and guide neuron alignment and model aggregation, addressing performance degradation caused by model drift and data heterogeneity.
